situations.headline: Vertex Minerals raises A$4.2M convertible loan facility with insider participation to fund Reward Gold Mine ramp-up

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Vertex Minerals raises A$4.2M convertible loan facility with insider participation to fund Reward Gold Mine ramp-up (interest 6, risk 6)

thesis.text: Vertex Minerals is a small-cap ASX gold developer transitioning the Reward Mine (Hill End, NSW) to underground production, using serial convertible loan financing (with insider participation from Executive Chairman Bruce McInnes) to bridge working capital ahead of cash flow from processing plant and ore sorter commissioning; near-term catalysts include the shareholder vote on conversion terms (deadline 31 Dec 2026) and Q1 2027 underground diamond drilling results, while dilution from conversion at a capped A$0.14 price and attached options remains the key overhang.
